summary: Backend-only review of /api/portal/market/* (Admin Portal → Market). New suite tests/test_portal_market_review.py: 27/27 pass. It covers the role matrix, real staff logins (customer_support gets 403 on brands, fixa and declutter; marketing can view but gets 403 on brand delete), brands (CRUD, 409 on duplicates, filters, featured, logo upload (415 for text), hide/restore with public 404/200), brand logins (portal + in-app admin give the same result), products/offers/images (public-files URLs fetch 200), banners (schedule, preview matches /shop/home, archive/restore, https route), FIXA (provider counts match the in-app admin; a real pending provider was approved → verified, suspended, reinstated, then put back to pending), Declutter (pause/restore/remove, 404, reports, in-app admin reports), audit trail and regression checks. The existing test_portal_market.py still passes 17/17. An edge-case probe found 6 behaviour issues (below). No 5xx errors.

critical.issue: When a brand is hidden, its published products stay visible to the public. GET /api/shop/products/{pid} returns 200, and the products still appear in /api/shop/search and /api/shop/products?category=. Only the retailer endpoints return 404. So a 'removed' brand's products can still be browsed (and probably added to the basket). shop.py product queries filter on product.published only, never on whether the retailer is published (e.g. shop.py:254, :409, :474).

minor.issue: Archiving sets active=false (admin_portal_market.py:646), but restore only clears archived_at (line 654). A restored banner comes back with active=false and live=false, so it does not reappear on /api/shop/home until someone PATCHes active=true. 'Restore' should bring the banner back live, or the API should clearly flag that it is inactive.

The route field is not validated. 'javascript:alert(1)' and 'not a route' are accepted with 201. The app passes any non-http route to router.push (frontend/src/components/shop/ShopBits.tsx:192). Only '/…' in-app paths or https:// should be allowed.

The image type is checked only from the Content-Type header the client sends. Non-image bytes labelled image/png are accepted (201) and stored as a PUBLIC file. Check the file's magic bytes (or open it with PIL) before storing.
A banner whose ends_at is already in the past is accepted (201, live=false). It should be rejected with 400, the same way past offer end dates are.
Unpublishing via PATCH does not set hidden_at or hidden_by. The DELETE route does, so the audit fields are inconsistent.
Offers on hidden (unpublished) products are listed as 'live'. The overview offers count correctly counts only published products, so the two disagree.
Returns 200 when the URL is not on the product, with no error and no indication that nothing was removed. Low priority.

action_items: HIGH: when a brand is hidden, hide its products from the public shop. Either filter shop product queries by published retailers, or cascade published=false to the products on hide and back on restore.
Banner restore: set active=true on restore (or document it and return a hint).
Validate the banner route: must start with '/' or https://.
Validate uploaded image bytes (magic bytes or PIL), not just the Content-Type header.
Reject banners created or patched with ends_at already in the past (optional).
In PATCH brand, set hidden_at when published=false; exclude unpublished products from /market/offers?status=live (optional).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_portal_market.py is 780 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting it into brands/products/banners/moderation modules.
Portal FIXA approve/suspend/reinstate and Declutter moderate call the same functions as the in-app admin (fixa.approve_provider, marketplace_v2.moderate_listing), so the two stay in step. Good.

PATCH /market/declutter/listings/{id} calls moderate_listing without checking the listing's category, so a FIXA 'services' listing id can be paused or removed through the Declutter route. Same 'marketplace' permission, so low risk.
Uploaded test images remain in object storage (no delete API). Harmless but not cleaned up.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested flows (27/27 plus 17/17 existing); 7 edge-case issues found by the probe (1 high, 6 minor)

seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ brands, products, accounts, banners, the listing, staff users and portal_media rows were deleted (verified 0 left over). The real pending FIXA provider that was approved/suspended/reinstated was restored to its original document (pending count back to 2). Note: the approval may have sent the provider a notification. Generating portal keys rotated the demo portal key, as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_portal_market_review.py plus test_portal_market.py. /portal/roles returns {roles:[{name,permissions}],modules,actions}. demo login returns 'token'. FIXA mutation test snapshots and restores the pending provider. Run helper_portal_market_probe.py to recheck the edge cases (it prints observed behaviour rather than asserting).
rca_of_issue: Hidden brand products still public: shop.py queries shop_products only by product.published, and hide_brand updates shop_retailers only. Repro: create brand + product → DELETE /portal/market/brands/{id} → GET /api/shop/products/{pid} returns 200. Banner restore: archive_banner sets active False, restore_banner doesn't reset it.
